Research notes (today = Monday, Oct 12, 2026; I took "Raptors" to mean the NBA's Toronto Raptors):

- The Raptors have no game on Monday, Oct 12. Their 2026 preseason schedule has games on Oct 3 and Oct 10, then none until Oct 13. The Wikipedia season page, the ESPN schedule and the sports schedule roundup from thesportscast.net all agree on this. The Wikipedia game log lists Oct 3 vs Miami, Oct 10 vs the Clippers, then Oct 13 vs New York.
- The next game is tomorrow, Tuesday, Oct 13. It is a preseason game against the New York Knicks. It is scheduled for 7:00 PM ET. It is at Scotiabank Arena in Toronto.
- Broadcast: Yahoo Sports/Action Network says it airs live on Sportsnet. A Fubo page lists MSG Sportsnet, which is likely the Knicks-side broadcast. The Sports Media Watch schedule lists Sportsnet (SN, SN+) for the home broadcast, and NBA League Pass.
- After that, the Raptors play at the Knicks on Thursday, Oct 15 at 7:30 PM ET, then at Detroit on Friday, Oct 16 at 7:00 PM ET. The regular season starts Tuesday, Oct 20. The Raptors' first regular-season game listed is Oct 21 vs Chicago at 7:30 PM ET.
- Several of the pages returned are dated after Oct 12. They show the Oct 13 game as already played. I left those out because they are later than today's date.
